profile.headline: Ninja Developer at CencosudX
profile.summary:
I am a professional with experience in software development and design of interfaces and user experiences for web, mobile and desktop applications. 
Good performance in multidisciplinary teams, with good communication and collaboration skills with developers, engineers and other team members. 
I am a creative, resourceful and committed professional, trained under good visual aesthetics and graphic design patterns, as well as their applications and trends. High degree of commitment to the user and the final product. Positive attitude towards new challenges and the need to learn new technologies.
